decisions.reason: Adding a panel slide switch does not change the main-board decoupling requirement.
The panel switch decision does not alter the addressable LEDs' power supply, switching, or logic-level handling.
The source adds a switch but does not establish whether it needs a distinct JST connection; the existing connector inventory already covers buttons and reset.
The added panel switch does not change standalone USB power activation, capacity, or powered scope.
The source specifies no GPIO assignment for the switch or additional buttons and does not alter any existing assignment.
The panel control addition does not change the monitored rail or current-monitor IC.
The panel switch requirement does not change the main-board power sources, OR-ing method, or source-selection behavior.
The source does not affect I2C series-resistor values, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The panel switch is unrelated to the battery-charge status indicator and CHGLED circuitry.
The source does not change either interboard connector, its signals, or its physical pin-order policy.
Adding a main-board panel switch does not alter power-board battery protection behavior.
The source concerns main-board panel controls and imposes no change on the power board's mechanical layout.
